snippet.title: The Most Brutal Queens in History (They Ruled Without Mercy)
snippet.description:
From empresses who blinded their own children to queens who executed rivals to keep their thrones, history has seen women who ruled with unmatched cruelty and cunning. In this video, we explore 90 of the most brutal queens across the world, their reigns, and the shocking deeds that made them infamous.

Discover:
 • Queens who ordered the execution of family members to secure power
 • Rulers who crushed rebellions with deadly force
 • Women who changed the course of history through fear and blood

Whether it’s Jezebel framing Naboth, Rani Lakshmibai leading deadly battles, or Elizabeth Báthory torturing servants, these queens show that power often came at a terrifying price.

📜 Dive into the dark side of royalty and see history like never before.

🔔 Don’t forget to like, subscribe, and hit the bell to explore more shocking stories from history.
